reason: The pilot costs us nothing and the exit terms are better than I expected, but I am not putting 950 members on a two-man product before I have seen Zwolle live and spoken to their board. On top of that, I hear a lot about admin and very little about how this earns me more from green fees, guests, the bar or sponsors.
objection: Two founders and a product nobody has run at a club our size yet. Escrow and monthly exports are nice on paper, but if they stop I am the one explaining to 950 members and the board why we have to migrate again, and I do not see the extra revenue that would make that risk worth it.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle live for a full season with real numbers, ideally including more guest green fees or bar spend through the app, and their board telling me on the phone it was worth it.
